classification.difficultyReason: Read each radius from its squared value, sketch an origin-centred circle and state its horizontal and vertical extent.

content.prompt: Sketch graphs of these circles, marking all intercepts with the axes, then write down the domain and range of each.

answer.short:
Intercepts: $(\pm1,0)$ and $(0,\pm1)$.

Domain: $-1\le x\le1$. Range: $-1\le y\le1$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}r^2&=1\\r&=1\end{align*}$$
The circle has centre $(0,0)$ and radius $1$. Setting $y=0$ gives $x=\pm1$; setting $x=0$ gives $y=\pm1$. Draw the circle through these four intercepts.

Domain: $-1\le x\le1$. Range: $-1\le y\le1$.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with equal axis scales and all four intercepts labelled.
